name: showreel-38-form
style: Dark look in the saffron colour world, whole frame, calm (E18 kept 15 Nov; E23 dynamic fix try 4; E20 caption ask try 2; BEFORE one clean drop with red signals, AFTER solid with a green lock; owner 15 Nov evening: too wiggly, similar colour grading)

voice.text: Why does your form jump? You type, and an error pops in. Everything under it moves, right as you tap. The fix: a min height of one line. The space stays, even when it is empty. Look closer. The message comes and goes, the button stays. Now your form holds still.

caption:
Has a form ever moved the button right as you tapped it? yes or never 👇

Live validation shows a message like "Enter a valid email" while you type and hides it once the email is valid. When the message element is empty it is 0 px tall, so every time it comes or goes, the Pay button and everything under it jump by one line. That is layout shift, and it makes people tap the wrong thing. The fix is one line: .error { min-height: 1lh; }. The lh unit is the element's own line height, so the slot always keeps exactly one line of room, empty or not, and the button never moves. lh works in Chrome 109+, Safari 16.4+ and Firefox 120+.
Send this to whoever builds your sign-up form, or save it for your next one. And answer in the comments: yes or never?

sources.note: MDN <length>: lh, a font-relative unit equal to the computed line-height of the element it is used on
BCD 8.1.9 (checked 15 Nov 2026), css.types.length.lh: Chrome 109, Firefox 120, Safari 16.4, Safari iOS 16.4, Chrome Android 109
MDN min-height: the element is never shorter than this, so an empty message block keeps its height

tip.title: Why does your form jump while you type?
tip.why: Live validation fills a message element while the input is invalid and empties it when it is valid. An empty block is 0 px tall, so the button and everything under it jump by one line each time. min-height: 1lh keeps one line of room in the slot (lh is the element's own line height), so nothing moves. lh works in Chrome 109+, Safari 16.4+ and Firefox 120+ (MDN, BCD).
